fields.name: fragment
fields.label: Event content fragment
fields.description: An Event content fragment (model: Event), e.g. from /content/dam/pensionsbc-base/<site>/events. Shown to everyone unless an audience below gets another fragment.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Swap for audience
fields.description: Visitors in this audience see the fragment below instead. The audience comes from the visitor's location (or ?audience= on the link) and lasts for the visit.

fields.name: audienceFragment
fields.label: Fragment for that audience
fields.description: The Event content fragment the audience above sees instead, e.g. the in-person session of the same topic.
